scope: Local branch candidate on stock CEF 154.0.34; no release or package
sourceBase: 2c34601 (rendered evidence and element actions under pinch zoom, unmerged) merged with main 8b73594
display: One 100% monitor; classic 15 CSS px scrollbars; 932x689 page view without the Elements panel, 509 px wide with it
coordinateModel: Window coordinates are page-window client pixels divided by display scale and browser zoom. CDP input coordinates are visual-viewport CSS pixels: window coordinates divided by the pinch scale (cssVisualViewport.scale). Both start at the window's page corner, where the visual viewport is drawn, so no pan offset separates them. Document points for DOM.getNodeForLocation add cssVisualViewport.pageX/pageY (layout scroll plus pinch pan).
humanInput: The pinch came from the AuthTest-only driver (Chromium SyntheticTouchpadPinchGesture). The person's hover was recorded by the same driver calling native_pointer with a client point, as the mouse hook would; no input was sent. The inspector was driven with posted window messages and read with PrintWindow. No physical mouse, touch or touchpad input was used, and the real cursor was not moved.

findings.humanPointer: Confirmed (source, then live): native_pointer stored a person's pointer in window coordinates in the same field as agent input coordinates. Under a 2x pinch the next agent motion began at twice the person's position: the page's first pointer event was at 183.69,171.86 for a person at 91.5,86.
findings.agentPointerOverlay: Confirmed (source, then live): the overlay drew agent input coordinates times display scale and browser zoom, without the pinch. After a click at input 230,173 its hotspot was at screen 766,544 instead of 996,717.
findings.inspectorHover: Confirmed (source, then live): developer_hit bounds-checked window coordinates against the layout viewport and added the layout scroll offset, so page picking at the window point of a listed control left another row selected.
findings.inspectorHighlight: Confirmed (found while testing): the highlight outline was drawn at input coordinates times display scale and browser zoom, at half size and position under a 2x pinch (pixels 296-428 x 304-326 instead of 345-607 x 526-568).

fix: The tab's last pointer stays in window coordinates. Each agent gesture records the pinch scale from its Page.getLayoutMetrics read; dispatched input positions are stored multiplied by it, the next motion starts from the stored position divided by the current scale, and an interrupted drag releases at the stored position divided by the gesture's scale. The overlay therefore needs no change. Inspector hover and picking convert window points through the current visual viewport (scale, bounds, document offset) and reject a viewport that scrolls, zooms or pans during matching. Highlights report their pinch pageScale, and the shell draws the outline at it.

beforeFix.note: Same source and suite with cef_engine.cpp and cef_shell.cpp at the base revision, plus only the AuthTest hover driver
